name: release-room
title: Release room
subtitle: Test evidence for a human release decision

sections.title: Readiness
sections.sql: select name,build,environment,total,passed,remaining,open_defects,decision from release_readiness order by due_on

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due,item

sections.title: Remaining work
sections.sql: select run,title,assignee,status from execution_status where state='open' and status<>'passed' order by due_on,title

sections.title: Traceability
sections.sql: select project,title,refs,version,approved_by,reviewed_on,runs,last_result from case_coverage order by project,title

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,item
